content:
jess_sales: FinNova POC - they want Private deployment connectivity options. Key asks: preserve client src IP, prefer customer egress proxy (TLS passthrough), strict firewall allowlist, and estimate of egress cost. POC window: 2 weeks. @sam_netops @alex_se can you advise? (cc: @marie_security)

sam_netops: Quick clarifying q: are they planning to route all inter-service traffic through their proxy or only outbound to Redwood?

jess_sales: outbound-only to Redwood inference endpoints. They have TGW in place but could do a single-spoke VPC if required.

alex_se: Options:
1) PrivateLink (interface endpoint) into our Private deployment control/data plane. Egress flows back out through customer network if they host a proxy in-front of us (but note: PrivateLink terminates TLS at the endpoint inside their VPC). Preserving original source IP is not possible through AWS ENI => we'd recommend X-Forwarded-For from our side.
2) VPC peering / TGW with static route to customer NAT/proxy. This preserves source IP if we originate from their VPC but increases cross-account routing complexity.
3) Transit/VPN handoff with NAT44 at the edge (we can map stable EIPs) — simpler for firewall allowlists but needs extra egress cost.

sam_netops: Firewall allowlist sample (customer side):
```
# Allow outbound to Redwood control plane & data plane
ALLOW TCP 443 -> redwood-control.example-cidr/32
ALLOW TCP 443 -> redwood-inference.example-cidr/32
# If using static EIP mapping (we provide eip list), allow that too
ALLOW TCP 443 -> 3.22.45.66
```

marie_security: Security note: if TLS is terminated by customer proxy, we need an assurance on certificate handling for user data (PII). Also ask FinNova to sign data processing addendum before POC. I'll start the questionnaire.

jess_sales: FinNova ask: can we test with our short-lived staging endpoint? They want to validate header preservation and latency.

alex_se: Yes — we can spin up a staging Private deployment in their VPC (requires infra ticket). For quick test: they can do a curl with Host header to verify routing via PrivateLink:

```bash
curl -v --resolve inference.redwood-staging:443:10.0.1.12 \
  -H "Host: inference.redwood-staging" \
  https://inference.redwood-staging/ping
```

This will exercise the interface endpoint and we can log X-Forwarded-For.

customer_net: Confirmed — we'll try the curl test. Also need a minimal firewall snippet (one here) and a timebox for the POC start (Mon next week).

alex_se: Pricing heads-up: Private deployment baseline + reserved throughput for POC. If we need static EIPs or NAT mapping there's a one-time config fee plus modest monthly EIP cost. Ballpark: add ~$1k–3k/month for POC depending on throughput and EIP mapping. I'll put a more specific delta in the quote.

sam_netops: Operational checklist for POC:
- Provide customer CIDR + TGW/VPC IDs
- Decide PrivateLink vs TGW (who owns NAT)
- Ticket for staging Private deploy (infra)
- Security DPA signed
- Firewall allowlist + test curl

deploy-bot: Ticket POC-1123 created (infra). Assignee: @infra-oncall

jess_sales: Great — I'll schedule kickoff and route the security questionnaire. @customer_net can you share CIDR + point-of-contact for your proxy team?

customer_net: Will share by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
